description: Use when PixelLab (Pixel Lab) or Pip skill context is present for setup/auth (PIXELLAB_SECRET, bearer token), MCP/API routing, asset generation, endpoint choice, SDK integration, sprites, sprite sheets, characters, portrait characters, objects, tiles, tilesets, tilemaps, maps, Godot/Unity map export, icons/UI/fonts, backgrounds, palettes, image edits, animation/VFX, talking portraits, vocal animations, talking GIFs, lip sync, skeleton/template/preset animation, looping/seamless or multi-shot cinematics, project art styles, animation inspection/repair, blueprints/recipes and `*.blueprint.json` replay, Workbench, Aseprite/Pixelorama, Game Builder, docs/troubleshooting or generations/cost/credit budgets. Do not trigger for Python pip/package management or generic image/pixel-art requests without PixelLab intent.
